name: conductor
description: Conductor orchestrator + 4 subagents (planning, research, implement, code-review) with their preloaded skills and MCP servers; each agent keeps native per-agent memory in the project's .claude/agent-memory/ Obsidian vault. Run /conductor:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS, CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0) in the project's .claude/settings.json.
